Supymem is a desktop app that runs on your computer with your own API keys,
Mac first, then Linux/Windows. Docker/browser is optional developer tooling.
Do not include API keys, customer records or personal data.

## Your problem

What are you trying to do, and what blocks you today?

## Your proposed change

Describe the smallest change that would help and how you would verify it works.

## Alternatives and scope

What have you tried? What should remain unchanged?
Note any effects on local storage, permissions, accessibility or consent.

## Your next step

Say whether you want to discuss the approach, test it or contribute a change.
